verdict.rationale: Attio's first-party docs include a dedicated webhooks guide: you subscribe to changes in Attio and receive real-time HTTP requests at a chosen target URL. Each request is cryptographically signed with an `Attio-Signature` header, and the OpenAPI document lists webhooks endpoints for programmatic registration. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence of the event-type catalog and delivery/retry semantics.
